verdict.rationale: A plugin platform could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so this axis applies. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI path returned 404. The other artifacts (llms.txt docs index, the marketplace.json catalog, the plugin.json manifest schema, a prose 'Checkout API reference') are adjacent and are not a downloadable OpenAPI-or-equivalent API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
